rules.description: Read only rule sources declared by the project contract.
Execute only the projected node and adjacent workflow edges.
A passing required step must bind evidence.
Revise the plan after project, goal, source, scope, owner, or rule-context drift.
Do not overwrite or delete plan revisions and execution events.
Do not claim lifecycle completion before canonical AppSDK gates pass.
New or changed control and configuration behavior must use declared typed control resources, error chains, or project configuration sources, never payloads, metadata, debug logs, or implicit context.
New or changed behavior must retain one semantic owner and one implementation, with no duplicate path, fallback, or temporary bypass.
Preserve fixed operation/hook/gate boundaries only where the project declares them. Missing required capabilities fail explicitly; never mock success.
Compare deletion, reuse and direct implementation by actual complexity. Optional simplification does not block; concrete quality, safety or ownership regressions remain forbidden.
Report untouched historical violations as recommendations; do not block the candidate unless they enter changed scope or affect safety, ownership, evidence truth, or required delivery.
Locate feature and debug work in the declared function and verification maps before implementation.
During debug exploration, append observations, hypotheses, and evidence to the active run notes before resolution.
Update function ownership and verification gates in the same change when the implementation changes them.
Record requirement, architecture, and detailed-design closure before feature implementation.
Check prior verified successes and failures before repeating exploration.

nodes.instruction: Run prepare and confirm scope, roots, boundaries, and acceptance.
Run idempotent initialization for the confirmed project root.
Verify the initialized governance baseline.

workflows.objective: Enter AppSDK governance without destroying existing project truth.

nodes.instruction: Inventory old governance truth and disposable runtime state.
Choose preserve-and-migrate or the explicitly authorized clean-epoch reset for each named control-plane owner.
Execute the canonical AppSDK migration/reset and the separate Collab migration/reset through their respective owners; never substitute one transaction for the other.
Verify the resulting single governance truth.

workflows.objective: Reconcile or reset legacy governance through an explicit, auditable route.

nodes.instruction: Confirm objective, scope, acceptance, non-goals, and owner.
Bind resource, function, mainline, verification, and module maps.
Create the clean owner worktree from latest origin/main.
Run the applicable AppSDK and project preflight checks.

workflows.objective: Bind goal, module, owner, maps, worktree, and required gates before code work.

nodes.instruction: Define the user-visible contract, scope, non-goals, acceptance, and required evidence; reuse an existing confirmed decision when present.
Read the declared function and verification maps, bind the owner, allowed and forbidden paths, required gates, and prior records, and note any map entry that the change must add.
For a new project or meaningful cross-module or semantic change, close top-down modules, resources, boundaries, and mainline flow; otherwise record why existing architecture is sufficient.
When the change introduces non-trivial behavior, close calls, data, errors, and verification mapping before implementation.
Implement the smallest change through the mapped owner in a clean owner worktree.
Create and bind the exact candidate commit and tree.
Run focused tests and mapped gates, then add build, install, restart, and same-entry replay only when the change affects those surfaces.
Update declared function ownership, paths, call edges, and verification gates when the validated change altered them.
Review the validated candidate against applicable quality, safety, evidence and owner contracts. Block concrete regressions; optional simplification and unrelated historical debt are advisory.
Check effectiveness identity and freshness; reuse valid unchanged candidate evidence and rerun only affected checks on drift.
Integrate on latest main and verify the exact integration tree.
Compile, publish Active, archive Protected, and freeze when required.
Record actual retained resources and owner or verified authorized removal. Delivery can complete with retention; do not claim Collab resource close before its cleanup requirements pass.

workflows.objective: Develop features through project context, proportionate design, exact validation, and verified cleanup.

nodes.instruction: Read project AGENTS, declared function and verification maps, and existing run notes and records; bind the failing request to an owner and required gates.
Append observations, one active hypothesis, confirmation and falsification signals, and evidence to run notes; reproduce when feasible and locate the first semantic divergence.
After causal evidence, fix the unique mapped owner, add proportionate regression coverage, and update maps or gates when their truth changed.
Create and bind the exact fix candidate.
Run focused tests and mapped gates, then choose build, install, restart, and original-input replay according to runtime impact.
Review the validated fix against applicable quality, safety, evidence and owner contracts. Block concrete regressions; optional simplification and unrelated historical debt are advisory.
Integrate on latest main and verify the exact tree.
Record evidence and actual retained resources or verified authorized removal; delivery and resource closure are separate.

workflows.objective: Orient to project truth, record evidence while exploring, and resolve through the unique mapped owner.

nodes.instruction: Pass AppSDK review admission for the exact candidate.
Run the user-selected or configured review route. Block concrete quality, safety, contract and material structural regressions; optional simplifications are advisory.
Replay effectiveness without source drift.

workflows.objective: Admit and review the exact evidence-bound candidate.

nodes.instruction: Run project-owned internal validation.
Build the exact candidate artifact.
Install the exact artifact into the declared environment.
Restart the declared runtime when required.
Replay through the public deployed entrypoint.
Bind whitebox, artifact, deployment, and blackbox evidence.

workflows.objective: Prove the candidate through its real deployed entrypoint.

nodes.instruction: Persist the exact error, durable IDs, source commit, installed binary, daemon PID/socket, and current task/bug binding; do not classify ACK, notification acceptance, health, or timeout as delivery.

Run `collab context` once and read the returned identity, route, daemon, task, inbox, and authority state. If the daemon is explicitly down or context returns a runtime error, preserve the exact error and stop; daemon maintenance is human-authorized.

If context returns `required_fields`, supply only those real facts once with `collab context --provide '<JSON>'`. The supplement may contain only requested `session_id`, `thread_id`, `endpoint`, or `namespace` facts; it never supplies a worker, approval, token, route, or binding. The daemon owns identity creation, selection, recovery, registration, route publication, and lease restoration. Do not choose or hunt a worker and do not run a separate recovery command.
Use the snapshot returned by context or its one factual supplement. Continue only when it is registered and the target route is live; otherwise preserve the exact failure and stop.
Replay the same native target through the installed binary and record the target result item; queue acceptance or a daemon health response alone is insufficient.

Consume the durable receipt for the target result through the canonical receive/consume operation; read-only inspection alone does not close. Update the bound bug or feature record and close only when the result and receipt evidence are present.

workflows.objective: Restore communication after an exact route, identity, daemon, or transport failure and prove the original native path again.

nodes.instruction: Fetch latest origin/main and refresh the integration base.
Verify the exact integrated tree and affected gates.
Merge and push through the protected mainline route.
Observe the remote main ref and bind its receipt.

workflows.objective: Merge only an exact candidate verified against latest main.

nodes.instruction: Run and bind the required merged-source regression suite.
Compile the canonical merged project artifact.
Publish the immutable Active artifact.

workflows.objective: Turn a verified mainline source into immutable consumable output.

nodes.instruction: Create the canonical Protected archive.
Bind source, artifact, API, regression, and promotion truth.
Verify Active and Protected immutability.

workflows.objective: Protect the exact published source, contracts, and artifact.

nodes.instruction: Record retained evidence and disposable state.
Remove the merged clean owner worktree and branch.
Release the task claim after worktree cleanup.

workflows.objective: Release only resources whose delivery and retention evidence is complete.
